TOPIC8.11
Volume with Washer
Method: Revolving
Around the x-or y-Axis
LEARNINGOBJECTIVE
CHA-5.C
Calculate volumes of solids
of revolution using definite
integrals.
ESSENTIALKNOWLEDGE
CHA-5.C.3
Volumes of solids of revolution around the x- or
y-axis whose cross sections are ring shaped
may be found using definite integrals with the
washer method.
ENDURINGUNDERSTANDING
CHA-5
Definite integrals allow us to solve problems involving the accumulation of change in
area or volume over an interval.
SUGGESTEDSKILLS
Communication and
Notation
4.E
Apply appropriate rounding
procedures.
